It is a substantial deciduous shrub growing to 4 meters (13 ft) tall and wide, with trifoliate gray-green leaves, and erect racemes of yellow flowers with a distinctive pineapple scent. description_text:
EnglishThis high-quality 3D model is crafted for use in a wide variety of digital applications including games, animations, virtual reality (VR), augmented reality (AR), 3D printing, and product visualization. It is provided in multiple popular file formats: FBX, OBJ, GLB, USDZ, STL, and BLEND, ensuring seamless compatibility with most 3D software and engines such as Blender, Unity, Unreal Engine, and more. Whether you're a game developer, designer, animator, or 3D printing enthusiast, this versatile asset will meet your creative needs with efficiency and realism.
GermanDieses hochwertige 3D-Modell ist für eine Vielzahl digitaler Anwendungen geeignet – darunter Spiele, Animationen, Virtual Reality (VR), Augmented Reality (AR), 3D-Druck und Produktvisualisierung. Es wird in den gängigen Formaten FBX, OBJ, GLB, USDZ, STL und BLEND bereitgestellt und ist mit den meisten 3D-Programmen wie Blender, Unity und Unreal Engine kompatibel. Ganz gleich, ob Sie Entwickler, Designer, Animator oder 3D-Druck-Enthusiast sind – dieses Modell wird Ihre kreativen Anforderungen erfüllen.
TurkishBu yüksek kaliteli 3D model; oyunlar, animasyonlar, sanal gerçeklik (VR), artırılmış gerçeklik (AR), 3D baskı ve ürün görselleştirme gibi çeşitli dijital uygulamalarda kullanılmak üzere hazırlanmıştır. FBX, OBJ, GLB, USDZ, STL ve BLEND gibi popüler dosya formatlarında sunulmakta olup Blender, Unity, Unreal Engine gibi çoğu 3D yazılımla uyumludur. İster oyun geliştiricisi, ister tasarımcı, animatör ya da 3D baskı tutkunu olun, bu model ihtiyaçlarınıza etkili ve gerçekçi bir çözüm sunacaktır.
FrenchCe modèle 3D de haute qualité est conçu pour une utilisation dans de nombreuses applications numériques telles que les jeux vidéo, l’animation, la réalité virtuelle (VR), la réalité augmentée (AR), l’impression 3D et la visualisation de produits. Il est fourni dans plusieurs formats populaires : FBX, OBJ, GLB, USDZ, STL et BLEND, garantissant une compatibilité avec la plupart des logiciels 3D tels que Blender, Unity et Unreal Engine. Que vous soyez développeur de jeux, designer, animateur ou passionné d'impression 3D, ce modèle répondra à vos besoins créatifs.
Korean이 고품질 3D 모델은 게임, 애니메이션, 가상현실(VR), 증강현실(AR), 3D 프린팅 및 제품 시각화 등 다양한 디지털 용도에 적합하게 제작되었습니다. FBX, OBJ, GLB, USDZ, STL, BLEND 형식으로 제공되며 Blender, Unity, Unreal Engine 등 대부분의 3D 소프트웨어와 호환됩니다. 게임 개발자, 디자이너, 애니메이터 또는 3D 프린팅 애호가에게 적합한 다용도 리소스입니다.

PolishTen wysokiej jakości model 3D doskonale sprawdzi się w wielu zastosowaniach cyfrowych – takich jak gry, animacje, rzeczywistość wirtualna (VR), rozszerzona rzeczywistość (AR), druk 3D czy wizualizacje produktów. Udostępniany jest w popularnych formatach FBX, OBJ, GLB, USDZ, STL i BLEND, co zapewnia kompatybilność z najpopularniejszymi programami 3D, takimi jak Blender, Unity i Unreal Engine. Niezależnie od tego, czy jesteś twórcą gier, animatorem, projektantem czy pasjonatem druku 3D – ten model będzie wartościowym zasobem.

SpanishEste modelo 3D de alta calidad está diseñado para una amplia gama de aplicaciones digitales, incluyendo videojuegos, animaciones, realidad virtual (VR), realidad aumentada (AR), impresión 3D y visualización de productos. Está disponible en múltiples formatos populares: FBX, OBJ, GLB, USDZ, STL y BLEND, lo que garantiza su compatibilidad con los principales programas y motores 3D como Blender, Unity y Unreal Engine. Ya seas desarrollador de juegos, diseñador, animador o entusiasta de la impresión 3D, este modelo te proporcionará una solución práctica y realista.
ItalianQuesto modello 3D di alta qualità è adatto a molteplici applicazioni digitali, tra cui videogiochi, animazioni, realtà virtuale (VR), realtà aumentata (AR), stampa 3D e visualizzazione di prodotti. Bu detaylı Topluluk Liderlik Madalyası 3D modeli, ödül töreni görselleştirmeleri, başarı kutlamaları veya topluluk hizmeti etkinlikleri için mükemmeldir. English:
This detailed 3D model of a Community Leadership Medal is perfect for award ceremony visualizations, achievement celebrations, or community service events. It accurately represents the symbolic elements of community leadership and service. Available in FBX, OBJ, STL, GLB, USDZ, and BLEND formats.
German:
Dieses detaillierte 3D-Modell einer Community-Leadership-Medaille eignet sich perfekt für Visualisierungen von Preisverleihungen, Erfolgsfeiern oder Veranstaltungen im Bereich des Gemeindedienstes. Es stellt die symbolischen Elemente von Community-Leadership und -Service akkurat dar. Verfügbar in den Formaten FBX, OBJ, STL, GLB, USDZ und BLEND.
Polski:
Ten szczegółowy model 3D Medalu Przywództwa Społecznego jest idealny do wizualizacji ceremonii wręczenia nagród, uroczystości osiągnięć lub wydarzeń związanych z służbą społeczną. Dokładnie reprezentuje symboliczne elementy przywództwa i służby społecznej. Dostępny w formatach FBX, OBJ, STL, GLB, USDZ i BLEND.
العربية:
هذا النموذج ثلاثي الأبعاد المفصل لميدالية القيادة المجتمعية مثالي لتصورات حفلات توزيع الجوائز أو احتفالات الإنجازات أو فعاليات خدمة المجتمع. إنه يمثل بدقة العناصر الرمزية للقيادة والخدمة المجتمعية. متوفر بتنسيقات FBX و OBJ و STL و GLB و USDZ و BLEND.
中文:
这款详细的社区领导力奖章 3D 模型非常适合颁奖典礼可视化、成就庆典或社区服务活动。它准确地表现了社区领导力和服务的象征元素。提供 FBX、OBJ、STL、GLB、USDZ 和 BLEND 格式。
한국어:
이 상세한 커뮤니티 리더십 메달 3D 모델은 시상식 시각화, 업적 축하 행사 또는 커뮤니티 서비스 이벤트에 적합합니다. 커뮤니티 리더십 및 서비스의 상징적 요소를 정확하게 나타냅니다. FBX, OBJ, STL, GLB, USDZ 및 BLEND 형식으로 제공됩니다.
Japanese:

description_text:
Alchemilla mollis flower Plant 01
Alchemilla mollis, the garden lady's-mantle or lady's-mantle is a species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. This herbaceous perennial plant is native to Southern Europe and grown throughout the world as an ornamental garden plant. It grows 30 to 45 cm (12 to 18 in) tall, with leaves that are palmately veined, with a scalloped and serrated margin. The stipules are noteworthy in that they are fused together and leaf like. The chartreuse yellow flowers are held in dense clusters above the foliage. A. mollis has gained the Royal Horticultural Society's Award of Garden Merit. The plant self-seeds freely and can become invasive.The plant is often grown as groundcover, and is valued for the appearance of its leaves in wet weather. Water beads on the leaves due to their dewetting properties. These beads of water were considered by alchemists to be the purest form of water. They used this water in their quest to turn base metal into gold, hence the name Alchemilla.] The Latin specific epithet mollis means soft, referring to the hairs on the leaves.

description_text:
John Michael Ozzy Osbourne (born 3 December 1948) is an English singer, songwriter, and media personality. He rose to prominence during the 1970s as the lead singer of the heavy metal band Black Sabbath, during which period he adopted the nickname Prince of Darkness.
Osbourne became a founding member of Black Sabbath in 1968, providing lead vocals from their self-titled debut album in 1970 to Never Say Die! in 1978. The band was highly influential in the development of heavy metal music, in particular their critically acclaimed releases Paranoid, Master of Reality, and Sabbath Bloody Sabbath. Osbourne was fired from Black Sabbath in 1979 due to problems with alcohol and other drugs. He then began a successful solo career with Blizzard of Ozz in 1980 and has released 13 studio albums, the first seven of which received multi-platinum certifications in the US. He has since reunited with Black Sabbath on several occasions. He rejoined in 1997 and helped record the group's final studio album, 13 (2013), before they embarked on a farewell tour that ended with a 2017 performance in their native Birmingham.
Osbourne has sold over 100 million albums, including his solo work and Black Sabbath releases.[4][5] He was inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame as a member of Black Sabbath in 2006 and as a solo artist in 2024. He was also inducted into the UK Music Hall of Fame both solo and with Black Sabbath in 2005. He has been honoured with stars on the Hollywood Walk of Fame and Birmingham Walk of Stars. At the 2014 MTV Europe Music Awards, he received the Global Icon Award. In 2015, he received the Ivor Novello Award for Lifetime Achievement from the British Academy of Songwriters, Composers and Authors.
In the early 2000s, Osbourne became a reality television star when he appeared in the MTV reality show The Osbournes alongside his wife and manager Sharon and two of their children, Kelly and Jack. He co-stars with Jack and Kelly in the television series Ozzy & Jack's World Detour. On 5 July 2025, Osbourne performed his final show at the Back to the Beginning concert event amid ongoing health battles, having announced earlier in the year that this would be his last live performance, though he intends to continue recording music.

description_text:
A golden trophy with fine engraving.
The Blender file also contains all visible models, materials with all packed textures and a well prepared lightning setup. The scene also contains a 360 degree animation with the plate and the trophy and the camera perspective is prepared for rendering the animation. Please note that the scene and all objects have approximately real sizes (the trophy has a diameter of about 100 millimetres, height is round about 170 mm).
The gold material as in the pictures is dynamically modified in Blender in the shader and thus cannot be baked directly. Nevertheless, the material in the exports is of high quality.In the textures.zip is the normal map and a additional roughness map available.
The print model (stl) contains the lettering in ultra high resolution printable 3D data, look in the following for the object data.You can find the number of faces in the respective filename of the export.
Attention:If after importing the object the metal looks light and cloudy, please check the roughness (Color Space should be sRGB) and the normal map (Color Space should be non color).
Please give me a like and support my work. Thank you!

In collaboration with others at Marvel—particularly co-writer/artists Jack Kirby and Steve Ditko—he co-created numerous popular fictional characters, including superheroes Spider-Man, the X-Men, Iron Man, Thor, the Hulk, Black Widow, the Fantastic Four, Black Panther, Daredevil, Doctor Strange, Scarlet Witch and Ant-Man. The superheroes he created seemed more meaningful and realistic.[2] In doing so, he pioneered a more naturalistic approach to writing superhero comics in the 1960s, and in the 1970s he challenged the restrictions of the Comics Code Authority, indirectly leading to changes in its policies. In the 1980s he pursued the development of Marvel properties in other media, with mixed results. Following his retirement from Marvel in the 1990s, he remained a public figurehead for the company, and frequently made cameo appearances in films and television shows based on Marvel characters, on which he received an executive producer credit. Meanwhile, he continued independent creative ventures into his 90s, until his death in 2018.
Lee was inducted into the comic book industry's Will Eisner Award Hall of Fame in 1994 and the Jack Kirby Hall of Fame in 1995. He received the NEA's National Medal of Arts in 2008.

  - temperature: 200°c/50°c

  - speed: 60mm/s, initial layer 50mm/s, brim 40mm/s

Coin holder slicer settings (everything the same except):

  - print it on the side like in the photo

  - layer: height 0.2, width 0.5

  - walls: 4 walls,fill gaps between walls everywhere

  - top/bottom: layers 2

Happy printing

description_text:
A single, drop‑in awards asset that combines a wooden stairs/podium stand with a gold trophy at center. The file includes four optional trophy designs you can swap in, so you get one cohesive model with easy style variations—ideal for sports promos, victory screens, event stages, motion graphics, and games.
What’s included

  - 1 assembled asset: stairs/podium stand with “WINNER” plaque and trophy

  - 4 optional trophy variants (classic, spiral, modern, etc.) included in the same file for quick swapping

  - Formats: Blender (.blend), FBX, OBJ (+MTL), glTF 2.0

  - High‑resolution PBR textures for wood and metal (BaseColor, Roughness, Metallic, Normal, AO)

Features

  - Clean topology and non‑overlapping UVs

  - you can change texts

  - Real‑world scale and centered pivots for easy placement

  - Materials set up for Blender (Cycles/Eevee) and easily portable to other DCCs/engines

  - Game/render ready; works great for real‑time and high‑res stills

How to use the variants

  - Blender: toggle the included trophy collections/objects (Trophy_01–Trophy_04) to switch styles

  - FBX/OBJ/glTF: all trophy variants are included as separate named meshes within the same asset for quick selection

Notes

  - Preview lighting/HDR and sparkles are for presentation only

  - Any branded logos shown in previews are not included; the “WINNER” plaque is included. I can provide a blank plaque or custom engraving on request

description_text:
Sculptures of Abstraction Challenge 1998
Beatrice Hoffman:

  - Absorbing the geometric and abstracting influences of African wood carvings,

  - I fitted this head into the shape of a triangle,

  - and experimented with the ensuing distortion of facial features:

  - very large eyes set against a very small mouth;

  - nose and eyebrows merging into one curved bow.

  - The small mouth (the only naturalistic element of this sculpture)

  - is a pivot point of the triangle:

  - with its downward tension,

  - it expresses disappointed expectation and frustrated demand building up to anger and sadness.

Dimensions: 80 cm x 30 cm

  - Materials is archive (material library)

  - Corona mtl + Vray mtl + Standard mtl

  - Polys: 13k + Verts: 13k

  - 4K texture + 4K material

  - JPEG (texture), MAX, FBX, OBJ

  - 3dmodels: MAX+FBX+OBJ

  - Corona render + Vray (Renderer Engine-MAX+FBX)

  - Scanline render (Renderer Engine-MAX+OBJ)

  - Models has unwrapped overlapping and

  - maps is real world scale

Note:

  - To use the max file you need to use at 3dsmax 2015

  - FBX 2012

  - Units: Centimeters

  - Clean Topology (quad mesh)

  - You Can Use Turbo Smooth

Chair Roche Bobois AVA  Contemporaries
Chair Modern Kitchen Garden Architecture
Design Song Wen Zhong
The Ava chair was inspired by the idea of mythical dragons and the design of Ming dynasty armchairs. It is a high-tech object, created using the modern technique of polycarbonate injection. It is manufactured by injection of Re-life polypropylene made of recycled industrial wasteLight and stackable, it is available in several opaque, glossy and matte shades. It was designed by Song Wen Zhong, a young Chinese designer who won the Roche Bobois Design Award based on the theme of Nature, universal link between East and West.
This matte version is made by injecting polypropylene from recycled industrial waste; it therefore does not use any new petroleum products during the manufacturing process.

description_text:
The pawn is the most numerous piece in the game of chess, and in most circumstances, also the weakest. It historically represents infantry, or more particularly, armed peasants or pikemen. Each player begins a game with eight pawns, one on each square of the rank immediately in front of the other pieces.
PLACEMENT AND MOVEMENT
Unlike the other pieces, pawns cannot move backwards. Normally a pawn moves by advancing a single square, but the first time a pawn moves, it has the option of advancing two squares. Pawns may not use the initial two-square advance to jump over an occupied square, or to capture. Any piece immediately in front of a pawn, friend or foe, blocks its advance. In the diagram, the pawn on c4 can move to c5; the pawn on e2 can move to either e3 or e4.

description_text:
Lionel Andrés Messi born 24 June 1987), also known as Leo Messi, is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a forward for Ligue 1 club Paris Saint-Germain and captains the Argentina national team. Widely regarded as one of the greatest players of all time, Messi has won a record seven Ballon d'Or awards,[note 2] a record six European Golden Shoes, and in 2020 was named to the Ballon d'Or Dream Team. Until leaving the club in 2021, he had spent his entire professional career with Barcelona, where he won a club-record 35 trophies, including 10 La Liga titles, seven Copa del Rey titles and four UEFA Champions Leagues. With his country, he won the 2021 Copa América and the 2022 FIFA World Cup. A prolific goalscorer and creative playmaker, Messi holds the records for most goals in La Liga (474), most hat-tricks in La Liga (36) and the UEFA Champions League (8), and most assists in La Liga (192) and the Copa América (17). He has also the most international goals by a South American male (98). Messi has scored over 790 senior career goals for club and country, and has the most goals by a player for a single club (672).
Born and raised in central Argentina, Messi relocated to Spain at the age of 13 to join Barcelona, for whom he made his competitive debut aged 17 in October 2004. He established himself as an integral player for the club within the next three years, and in his first uninterrupted season in 2008–09 he helped Barcelona achieve the first treble in Spanish football; that year, aged 22, Messi won his first Ballon d'Or. Three successful seasons followed, with Messi winning four consecutive Ballons d'Or, making him the first player to win the award four times. During the 2011–12 season, he set the La Liga and European records for most goals scored in a single season, while establishing himself as Barcelona's all-time top scorer. The following two seasons, Messi finished second for the Ballon d'Or behind Cristiano Ronaldo (his perceived career rival), before regaining his best form during the 2014–15 campaign, becoming the all-time top scorer in La Liga and leading Barcelona to a historic second treble, after which he was awarded a fifth Ballon d'Or in 2015. Messi assumed captaincy of Barcelona in 2018, and in 2019 he won a record sixth Ballon d'Or. Out of contract, he signed for Paris Saint-Germain in August 2021.
An Argentine international, Messi holds the national record for appearances and is also the country's all-time leading goalscorer. At youth level, he won the 2005 FIFA World Youth Championship, finishing the tournament with both the Golden Ball and Golden Shoe, and an Olympic gold medal at the 2008 Summer Olympics. His style of play as a diminutive, left-footed dribbler drew comparisons with his compatriot Diego Maradona, who described Messi as his successor. After his senior debut in August 2005, Messi became the youngest Argentine to play and score in a FIFA World Cup in 2006, and reached the final of the 2007 Copa América, where he was named young player of the tournament. As the squad's captain from August 2011, he led Argentina to three consecutive finals: the 2014 FIFA World Cup, for which he won the Golden Ball, and the 2015 and 2016 Copa América, winning the Golden Ball in the 2015 edition. After announcing his international retirement in 2016, he reversed his decision and led his country to qualification for the 2018 FIFA World Cup, a third-place finish at the 2019 Copa América, and victory in the 2021 Copa América, while winning the Golden Ball and Golden Boot for the latter. This achievement would see him receive a record seventh Ballon d'Or in 2021. In 2022, he captained his country to win the 2022 FIFA World Cup, for which he won the Golden Ball for a record second time, and broke the record for most appearances in World Cup tournaments with 26 matches played.
Messi has endorsed sportswear company Adidas since 2006. According to France Football, he was the world's highest-paid footballer for five years out of six between 2009 and 2014, and was ranked the world's highest-paid athlete by Forbes in 2019 and 2022. Messi was among Time's 100 most influential people in the world in 2011 and 2012. In February 2020, he was awarded the Laureus World Sportsman of the Year, thus becoming the first footballer and the first team sport athlete to win the award. Later that year, Messi became the second footballer and second team-sport athlete to surpass $1 billion in career earnings

The MaskThe Mask is a 1994 American superhero comedy film directed by Chuck Russell and produced by Bob Engelman from a screenplay by Mike Werb and a story by Michael Fallon and Mark Verheiden. It is the first installment in the Mask franchise, based on the comics published by Dark Horse Comics. It stars Jim Carrey in the title role along with Peter Riegert, Peter Greene, Amy Yasbeck, Richard Jeni, and Cameron Diaz in her film debut. Carrey plays Stanley Ipkiss, an ordinary man who finds a magical wooden green mask that transforms him into the Mask, a green-faced troublemaker with the ability to animate and alter himself and his surroundings at will. Filming began on August 30, 1993, and concluded in October 1993.
The film was released on July 29, 1994, by New Line Cinema, becoming a critical and commercial success. The film grossed over $351 million on an $18–23 million budget, which made it the most profitable film based on a comic up to that point. The film also influenced the resurgence of swing music in the 1990s. It cemented Carrey's reputation as a significant actor of the 1990s, and it established Diaz as a leading lady. Carrey was nominated for a Golden Globe for his role, and the film was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Visual Effects, but lost to Forrest Gump. A standalone sequel without Jim Carrey, Son of the Mask, was released in 2005 to critical and commercial failure.

description_text:
Hello! My name is Mauricio, and I'm a designer based in Argentina, specializing in creating high-quality 3D models for a wide range of purposes and applications.
One of my standout projects is the replica of the Champions League trophy. Using advanced SolidWorks modeling techniques and realistic rendering with Keyshot, I've managed to capture every detail and curve of this iconic piece. From the intricate handles to the distinctive texture of the base, my model offers a faithful and accurate representation of this emblematic symbol of European football.
To meet the needs of my clients, I provide a variety of file formats, including .STL, .OBJ, .FBX, .BLEND, .IGS, and .SLDPRT. This ensures easy integration into a variety of programs and platforms, from design applications to virtual reality projects.
Furthermore, I offer customized file conversion services. If you need your model in a specific format or have special requirements, feel free to contact me. I'm here to help you bring your ideas to life and take your projects to the next level.
Whether you're a graphic designer, a game developer, an architect, or a 3D modeling enthusiast, I'm here to assist you in realizing your visions. My skills and experience are at your disposal to transform your concepts into high-quality, ready-to-use 3D models.
Don't hesitate to contact me via email: mauricio.fredes@mi.unc.edu.ar.
Mauricio Fredes3D Designer
------------- ESPAÑOL --------------------
Hola! Mi nombre es Mauricio y soy un diseñador radicado en Argentina, especializado en la creación de modelos 3D de alta calidad para una amplia gama de propósitos y aplicaciones.
Uno de mis proyectos destacados es la réplica del  trofeo de la UEFA Champions League. Utilizando avanzadas técnicas de modelado en SolidWorks y realismo en renderización con Keyshot, he logrado capturar cada detalle y curva de esta emblemática pieza. Desde las intrincadas asas hasta la textura distintiva de la base, mi modelo ofrece una representación fiel y precisa de este símbolo icónico del fútbol europeo.
Para satisfacer las necesidades de mis clientes, proporciono una variedad de formatos de archivo, incluyendo .STL, .OBJ, .FBX, .BLEND, .IGS y .SLDPRT. Esto garantiza una fácil integración en una variedad de programas y plataformas, desde aplicaciones de diseño hasta proyectos de realidad virtual.
Además, ofrezco servicios de conversión de archivos a medida. Si necesitas tu modelo en un formato específico o tienes requisitos especiales, no dudes en ponerte en contacto conmigo. Estoy aquí para ayudarte a materializar tus ideas y llevar tus proyectos al siguiente nivel.
Ya sea que seas un diseñador gráfico, un desarrollador de videojuegos, un arquitecto o un entusiasta del modelado 3D, estoy aquí para ayudarte a hacer realidad tus visiones. Mis habilidades y experiencia están a tu disposición para transformar tus conceptos en modelos 3D de alta calidad y listos para su uso.
No dudes en contactarme a través de mi correo electrónico: mauricio.fredes@mi.unc.edu.ar
Mauricio FredesDiseñador 3D
----------------------- DEUTSCH --------------------------
Hallo! Mein Name ist Mauricio, und ich bin ein leidenschaftlicher Designer aus Argentinien, spezialisiert auf die Erstellung hochwertiger 3D-Modelle für eine Vielzahl von Zwecken und Anwendungen.
Eines meiner herausragenden Projekte ist die Nachbildung des UEFA Champions League-Pokals. Mit fortgeschrittenen SolidWorks-Modellierungstechniken und realistischer Renderings mit Keyshot ist es mir gelungen, jedes Detail und jede Kurve dieses ikonischen Stücks einzufangen. Von den komplizierten Griffen bis zur charakteristischen Textur des Sockels bietet mein Modell eine treue und genaue Darstellung dieses emblematischen Symbols des europäischen Fußballs.
Um den Bedürfnissen meiner Kunden gerecht zu werden, biete ich eine Vielzahl von Dateiformaten an, darunter .STL, .OBJ, .FBX, .BLEND, .IGS und .SLDPRT. Dies gewährleistet eine einfache Integration in eine Vielzahl von Programmen und Plattformen, von Designanwendungen bis hin zu Virtual-Reality-Projekten.
Darüber hinaus biete ich maßgeschneiderte Dateikonvertierungsdienste an. Wenn Sie Ihr Modell in einem bestimmten Format benötigen oder spezielle Anforderungen haben, zögern Sie nicht, mich zu kontaktieren. Ich stehe Ihnen zur Verfügung, um Ihre Ideen zum Leben zu erwecken und Ihre Projekte auf die nächste Stufe zu heben.
Egal, ob Sie Grafikdesigner, Spieleentwickler, Architekt oder 3D-Modellierungs-Enthusiast sind, ich stehe Ihnen zur Seite, um Ihre Visionen zu verwirklichen. Meine Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen stehen Ihnen zur Verfügung, um Ihre Konzepte in hochwertige, einsatzbereite 3D-Modelle zu verwandeln.
Zögern Sie nicht, mich per E-Mail zu kontaktieren: mauricio.fredes@mi.unc.edu.ar.
Mauricio Fredes3D-Designer
------------------ ITALIANO -------------------
Ciao! Il mio nome è Mauricio e sono un designer appassionato con sede in Argentina, specializzato nella creazione di modelli 3D di alta qualità per una vasta gamma di scopi e applicazioni.
Uno dei miei progetti più distintivi è la replica del trofeo della UEFA Champions League. Utilizzando avanzate tecniche di modellazione in SolidWorks e renderizzazione realistica con Keyshot, sono riuscito a catturare ogni dettaglio e curva di questo pezzo iconico. description_text:
Lithophany Comic Book The Eternaut
The Eternaut is an Argentine science fiction serial created by screenwriter Héctor Germán Oesterheld (1919-1978) and cartoonist Francisco Solano López (1928-2011). Published in Hora Cero Semanal from 1957 to 1959, it had numerous sequels and reissues.
The plot centers on an alien invasion of Earth via a toxic snowstorm that wipes out most of the population, and the resistance of survivors in Buenos Aires. Its protagonist is Juan Salvo, the Eternauta, who, in an exercise in metafiction, narrates what happened to Oesterheld.
The comic is considered one of the most important in the country and in Latin America. Its 2015 Fantagraphics Books edition for the United States received three Eisner Award nominations and won in the category of Best Newspaper Comics Collection or Archival Project.
In early 2020, the streaming platform Netflix announced the international adaptation of The Eternaut.
The series was released in April 2025 and became Netflix's third most-watched series globally.

description_text:
The Ballon d'Or 'Golden Ball' is an annual football award presented by French magazine France Football since 1956 to honour the player deemed to have performed the best over the previous season.
Conceived by sports writers Gabriel Hanot and Jacques Ferran, the Ballon d'Or was based exclusively on voting by football journalists up until 2006. Originally, it was awarded only to players from Europe and was widely known as the European Footballer of the Year award. In 1995, the Ballon d'Or was expanded to include all players of any origin that have been active at European clubs. The award became a global prize in 2007 with all professional footballers from around the world being eligible; additionally, coaches and captains of national teams were also given the right to vote, before reverting to just journalists in 2016.
Between 2010 and 2015, in an agreement with FIFA, the award was merged with the FIFA World Player of the Year, and was known as the FIFA Ballon d'Or. That partnership ended in 2016, and the award reverted to the Ballon d'Or, while FIFA also reverted to its own separate annual award, The Best FIFA Men's Player. In 2022, France Football modified the rules for the Ballon d'Or. The timing was changed so that awards were given not for achievements during a calendar year, but for a football season, and it was also determined that an international jury of specialized journalists, with one representative per country, from the top 100 in the latest FIFA Men's World Ranking would elect the winner of the award. UEFA co-organizes the Ballon d'Or gala since 2024, with France Football retaining the voting system and the Ballon d'Or name.

description_text:
3D model descriptionRobert Rocky Balboa (also known by his ring name the Italian Stallion) is a fictional character and the titular protagonist of the Rocky franchise. The character was created by Sylvester Stallone, who has also portrayed him in eight of the nine films in the franchise. He is depicted as a working class or poor Italian-American from the slums of Philadelphia who started out as a club fighter and enforcer for a local Philly Mafia loan shark. He is portrayed as overcoming the obstacles that had occurred in his life and in his career as a professional boxer.
While the story of his first film was partly inspired[citation needed] by a 1975 fight between underdog Chuck Wepner and heavyweight champion Muhammad Ali (which nearly went the 15 round distance despite the odds), the inspiration for the name, iconography and fighting style came from boxing legend Rocco Francis Rocky Marciano Marchegiano, though his surname coincidentally also resembles that of Middleweight Boxing Champion Thomas Rocco Rocky Graziano Barbella.
The character is widely considered to be Stallone's most iconic role and is often considered the role that started his film career. He received critical acclaim for his performance in the first movie, earning Academy Award and Golden Globe Award nominations. When Stallone reprised his role once again in 2015 for Creed, his performance received universal acclaim and he received his first Golden Globe Award for Best Supporting Actor, along with his third[2] Oscar nomination for Best Supporting Actor, the National Board of Review Award for Best Supporting Actor and several other accolades.

description_text: In Japan, a tōrō (灯籠 or 灯篭, 灯楼, light basket, light tower) is a traditional lantern made of stone, wood, or metal. Like many other elements of Japanese traditional architecture, it originated in China; where they can still be found in Buddhist temples and Chinese gardens. They are not as common in Korea as they are in China or Japan.[1] In Japan, tōrō were originally used only in Buddhist temples, where they lined and illuminated paths. Lit lanterns were then considered an offering to Buddha. Their use in Shinto shrines and also private homes started during the Heian period (794–1185).

description_text:
Sculptures of Abstraction Nurturing 2002Bronze Resin
Beatrice Hoffman:
Written By The Art Critic Patricia Preece:“This work shows two faces locked together in the most way, but their gaze is strangely distant.The strength of the work is the tension that exists between the two heads which are bound together.The mother figure angles her cheek to her child in a responsive manner but faces away with her eyes fixed to the horizon.
At the same time the child nuzzles the mother,but its kiss is a pout that tells us that it knows that the time for nurturing is over.The nurturer and the nurturer are also the rejecter and the rejected =to encapsulated this using such economy of means is an amazing feat.It is this that makes the figure truly modern. I love you, says the big heads,but it's time you moved on – me and your dad have got things we want to do.”
There is movement of the right head pulling away from the left, lower head .I thought of a human bird chick (on the left), that greedily demands food of its mother – pecking kissing, feeding.The space between the two is cramped. Within their shared closeness it shows need, dependency on the one hand,and the longing to find freedom from the responsibility of care on the other. With the sizes of the heads being quite similar,there is ambivalence: are they mother and child, or lovers reproducing that first intense love affair at the beginning of life?

description_text:
Give your heroes the grand ceremony they deserve with this epic throne room dais diorama, perfectly scaled for 3.75-inch action figures!
Recreate one of the most triumphant moments in cinematic history with this detailed and authentic backdrop. Inspired by the Great Temple throne room from a classic 1977 space fantasy film, this diorama piece provides the perfect setting for your 1/18 scale rebel heroes, scoundrels, and princesses. It's an essential environmental piece for collectors, toy photographers, and anyone looking to create the ultimate display for their collection.
This model has been carefully designed to capture the ancient, monumental feel of the location, from the texture of the weathered stone blocks to the iconic, high-backed chairs awaiting the heroes. Stop letting your figures stand on a boring shelf—give them a world to inhabit!
Key Features:
Perfectly Scaled: Meticulously designed for 1:18 scale, making it the ideal companion for classic 3.75-inch action figure lines, including the Vintage Collection and Retro figures.
Cinematic Accuracy: Features the iconic raised circular platform, wide, shallow steps, and the two distinctive, high-backed chairs, allowing you to replicate the famous final scene with incredible accuracy.
High-Detail Texture: The floor and steps are sculpted with a realistic weathered stone block texture, which looks fantastic right off the printer and provides a perfect canvas for painting and weathering.
Optimized for Printing: Designed as a large, stable diorama piece. The model can be printed in one piece on larger printers or easily sliced into sections to accommodate smaller build plates. It is optimized for FDM printing.
Why You'll Love This Model:
Create the Ultimate Display: Transform your collection from a group of figures into a stunning, dynamic scene that captures a legendary moment.
Perfect for Toy Photography: The scale, detail, and iconic design make this an incredible backdrop for creating cinematic-quality photos of your figures.
Easy to Print and Finish: The strong, geometric shapes are ideal for FDM printing, and the stone texture is forgiving, making it a satisfying project for all skill levels. A simple stone-colored filament and a dark wash are all you need to make it look amazing!
A Nostalgic Masterpiece: Build and display a piece of your childhood and celebrate the heroes of a galaxy far, far away.
Recommended Print Settings:
Printer: FDM printers are ideal for this model.
Layer Height: 0.2mm - 0.28mm for a good balance of speed and detail.
Infill: 10-15% is sufficient.
Supports: No supports are required for this model!
Material: PLA or PETG in a stone, sand, or grey color works perfectly.
Download this incredible diorama piece today and host an award ceremony worthy of a galactic hero!"

description_text:
Give your heroes the grand ceremony they deserve with this epic throne room dais diorama, perfectly scaled for 3.75-inch action figures!
Recreate one of the most triumphant moments in cinematic history with this detailed and authentic backdrop. Inspired by the Great Temple throne room from a classic 1977 space fantasy film, this diorama piece provides the perfect setting for your 1/18 scale rebel heroes, scoundrels, and princesses. It's an essential environmental piece for collectors, toy photographers, and anyone looking to create the ultimate display for their collection.
This model has been carefully designed to capture the ancient, monumental feel of the location, from the texture of the weathered stone blocks to the iconic, high-backed chairs awaiting the heroes. Stop letting your figures stand on a boring shelf—give them a world to inhabit!
Key Features:
Perfectly Scaled: Meticulously designed for 1:18 scale, making it the ideal companion for classic 3.75-inch action figure lines, including the Vintage Collection and Retro figures.
Cinematic Accuracy: Features the iconic raised circular platform, wide, shallow steps, and the two distinctive, high-backed chairs, allowing you to replicate the famous final scene with incredible accuracy.
High-Detail Texture: The floor and steps are sculpted with a realistic weathered stone block texture, which looks fantastic right off the printer and provides a perfect canvas for painting and weathering.
Optimized for Printing: Designed as a large, stable diorama piece. The model can be printed in one piece on larger printers or easily sliced into sections to accommodate smaller build plates. It is optimized for FDM printing.
Why You'll Love This Model:
Create the Ultimate Display: Transform your collection from a group of figures into a stunning, dynamic scene that captures a legendary moment.
Perfect for Toy Photography: The scale, detail, and iconic design make this an incredible backdrop for creating cinematic-quality photos of your figures.
Easy to Print and Finish: The strong, geometric shapes are ideal for FDM printing, and the stone texture is forgiving, making it a satisfying project for all skill levels. A simple stone-colored filament and a dark wash are all you need to make it look amazing!
A Nostalgic Masterpiece: Build and display a piece of your childhood and celebrate the heroes of a galaxy far, far away.
Recommended Print Settings:
Printer: FDM printers are ideal for this model.
Layer Height: 0.2mm - 0.28mm for a good balance of speed and detail.
Infill: 10-15% is sufficient.
Supports: No supports are required for this model!
Material: PLA or PETG in a stone, sand, or grey color works perfectly.
Download this incredible diorama piece today and host an award ceremony worthy of a galactic hero!"

EOTECH is an American company that designs, manufactures, and markets electro-optic products and systems. The company is headquartered in Ann Arbor, Michigan. They produce holographic weapon sights for small arms that have been adopted by various military and law enforcement agencies as close quarters battle firearm sights.
They also have roots in the Environmental Research Institute of Michigan (ERIM), a non-profit R&D institute. Of the many inventions by ERIM researchers, some were in the fields of synthetic aperture radar, laser holography, and aircraft head-up displays. The first-generation holographic sight was introduced by EOTech—then an ERIM subsidiary—at the 1996 SHOT Show, under the trade name HoloSight by Bushnell (with whom the company was partnered with at the time), initially aiming for the civilian sport shooting and hunting market. It won the Optic of the Year Award from the Shooting Industry Academy of Excellence

title: Smiley animated emoticon 3D model
description_text:
A smiley, sometimes referred to as a smiley face, is a basic ideogram that represents a smiling face. Since the 1950s it has become part of popular culture worldwide, used either as a standalone ideogram, or as a form of communication, such as emoticons. The smiley began as two dots and a line to represent eyes and a mouth. More elaborate designs in the 1950s emerged, with noses, eyebrows, and outlines. The first time yellow and black design was by the radio station, WMCA for its Good Guys campaign in the early 1960s. More yellow and black designs appeared in the 1960s and 70s including works by Franklin Loufrani and Harvey Ross Ball. Today, The Smiley Company holds many rights to the smiley ideogram and has become one of the biggest licensing companies globally.
The name smiley wasn't used until the 1970s when Loufrani trademarked the name and his design in France while he was working as a journalist for France Soir. Competing terms were used such as smiling face and happy face before consensus was reached on the term smiley. When the term smiley became more commonly used, the spelling smilie was used by some, but today the common spelling is with ey.
Today, the smiley face has evolved from an ideogram into a template for communication and use in written language. This began with Scott Fahlman in the 1980s when he first theorized ascii characters could be used to create faces and demonstrate emotion in text. Since then, those Fahlman's designs have become digital pictograms, known as emoticons. They are loosely based on the ideograms designed in the 1960s and 70s, continuing with the yellow and black design.

My Neighbor Totoro (Japanese: となりのトトロ, Hepburn: Tonari no Totoro) is a 1988 Japanese animated fantasy film written and directed by Hayao Miyazaki and animated by Studio Ghibli for Tokuma Shoten. The film—which stars the voice actors Noriko Hidaka, Chika Sakamoto, and Hitoshi Takagi—tells the story of a professor's two young daughters (Satsuki and Mei) and their interactions with friendly wood spirits in post-war rural Japan. The film won the Animage Anime Grand Prix prize and the Mainichi Film Award and Kinema Junpo Award for Best Film in 1988. It also received the Special Award at the Blue Ribbon Awards in the same year.

description_text: Each side starts with two rooks, one on the queenside and one on the kingside. All four rooks are located in the corners of the board. White's rooks start the game on a1 and h1, while Black's rooks are located on a8 and h8.  The rook is considered a major piece (like the queen) and is worth five points. It can move as many squares as it likes left or right horizontally, or as many squares as it likes up or down vertically (as long as it isn't blocked by other pieces). An easy way to remember how a rook can move is that it moves like a + sign.

description_text:
UEFA Champions League trophy 3D model
The current UEFA Champions League trophy stands 73.5cm tall and weighs 7.5kg.A rule introduced in 1968/69 stipulates that the cup becomes the property of any club who win the competition five times or three years in a row. The club then start a new cycle from zero. Real Madrid, Ajax, Bayern München, Milan and Liverpool all have a version in their trophy rooms. The rule was changed ahead of 2008/09, with the original trophy remaining with UEFA and the clubs awarded a replica.The current trophy is the fifth version of the current design. It was commissioned by UEFA General Secretary Hans Bangerter after Real Madrid were allowed to keep the original in 1967.It was designed and made in Berne (near UEFA's then headquarters) by Jürg Stadelmann.Jürg Stadelmann recalled: My father Hans and I went along to Herr Bangerter's office and covered the whole floor with drawings. He made comments like, 'The Bulgarians would like the bottom of that. The Spaniards would like this but the Italians would prefer that and the Germans would go for this.' We put the design together like a jigsaw puzzle.The trophy took 340 hours to make, with Stadelmann meeting a strict deadline. It had to be finished before 28 March, Stadelmann added, because I was getting married and taking my wife on a ten-day boat trip to Los Angeles. I did the finer work, then it was finished off by the engraver, Fred Bänninger. On time, I am glad to say.

description_text:
Mammillaria elongata, the gold lace cactus or ladyfinger cactus, is a species of flowering plant in the family Cactaceae, native to central Mexico. Growing to 15 cm (6 in) tall by 30 cm (12 in) wide, it consists of densely packed clusters of elongated oval stems, covered in harmless (although very sharp) yellow or brown spines, and in spring producing white or yellow flowers. It is among the most common and most variable of its genus in nature, and is a popular subject for cultivation. It has gained the Royal Horticultural Society's Award of Garden Merit.

description_text:
Symbol of Elegance and Triumph
This stunning Golden Wreath wall art captures the essence of classical beauty and victory. Designed with intricate leaf patterns and a circular layout, it brings a touch of sophistication to any space. Perfect for home decor, galleries, or ceremonial backdrops.
Printing Details
Layer Height: 0.1–0.2 mm for a smooth finish.
Supports Required: Yes, especially for intricate leaves or overhangs.
Infill Density: 10–15% to keep the piece lightweight.
Print Orientation: Lay flat for minimal supports and consistent quality.
Post-Printing Instructions
Sanding: Gently sand edges and surfaces to remove any printing artifacts.
Painting:  Apply a primer, followed by metallic gold spray paint or acrylics for a luxurious finish.
Detailing: Use a small brush to add depth with darker gold or bronze highlights.
Sealing: Apply a clear coat for protection and to enhance the metallic sheen.
Mounting: Attach adhesive hooks, screws, or double-sided tape for wall display.
